headline: 影剧双热：《最后的曙光》登顶，侠探杰克霸屏
headlineEn: Dawn of the Last Light tops movies, Reacher dominates TV
summary: 今日3部新片上映，本周累计8部新片入市；电影《最后的曙光》登顶今日热度，剧集《侠探杰克》领跑电视榜，双线热度持续升温。
summaryEn: Three movies opened today, eight this week. Movie 'The Last Dawn' tops daily film heat, while series 'Reacher' leads TV charts.

industryHighlights.text: 今日3部新片上映，本周共8部新片入市。
industryHighlights.en: Three movies opened today; eight new titles hit theaters this week.

industryHighlights.text: 电影《最后的曙光》登顶今日电影热度榜。
industryHighlights.en: Movie 'The Last Dawn' topped today's film heat chart.

industryHighlights.text: 剧集《侠探杰克》领跑今日电视榜，IP热度延续到影视双端。
industryHighlights.en: Series 'Reacher' leads today's TV rankings, with IP heat spanning both film and TV.

industryHighlights.text: 《玩具总动员5》稳居本周电影热度前三。
industryHighlights.en: 'Toy Story 5' remains in the top three of weekly movie heat.

industryHighlights.text: 《Ted Lasso》本周电视热度持续走高，喜剧串流表现亮眼。
industryHighlights.en: 'Ted Lasso' keeps climbing weekly TV heat with strong comedy streaming.
